image.alt: A drawing from above of the excavated Neolithic settlement at Mehrgarh: a grid of contiguous rectangular sun-dried mud-brick structures, part-excavated, partitioned into small rooms and compartmentalised storage bins.

options.text: The charred grain: grain in a hearth proves that the people grew it.
The animal bones: bones prove that the animals were kept in herds.
The storage bins: nobody stores food without a harvest.
No single find. Grain of farmed kinds, bins to store it and bones of herded animals together point to farming.
